svg.aria-label: Six model families independently produce the same coordinate beats for the same six places
svg.text: 6 model families. Different training data, different architectures,
different organisations. No shared weights. No shared embedding. No shared context.
Never shown another lane. Each answered which of 45 plain statements were true
about one place, in English, once.
band runs unbroken: every family produced this beat identically
band breaks: this beat differs between families
Same place came out nearest in 87 of 90 cross-family comparisons (96.7%) · chance is 16.7%
90 of 90 if exact ties are also counted (100.0%). 3 of 24 whole beats are character-for-character identical across all 6; the rest differ by a syllable or two.
Read the columns, not the letters. A lane is not required to spell the place the same way. It is required to put it in the same place.
This is not a claim that the models understand the place. They were handed the 45 statements and used them consistently. What it shows is that the frame is usable by minds with nothing in common.
